scope: Owned synthetic native SQLite/D1 custody, administrator API, built CLI over local trusted TLS, and offline physical restore. No production or provider operation.

results.packed_cli_and_client_smoke: passed with both tarballs built from this source; these 0.1.4-labelled candidate artifacts are not the earlier public 0.1.4 release

assertions: Full immutable custody identity, closure request and current review instance are checked atomically with current administrator session and provider lease.
Old-incarnation and closed-account/late-grant cleanup is available; current-owner Microsoft confirmation remains separate.
Identical replay does not duplicate evidence; changed identity/evidence, stale role, revoked session, quarantine and active lease are refused.
Operator evidence is immutable, never labelled provider verification, and never returned verbatim by the API.
Old source and old reviewer incarnations are excluded from reused-ID closure inventory attribution.
Actual physical backup/restore remains quarantined; read-only inspection reveals no grant; existing privacy replay/release precedes fresh administrator confirmation and successful new connection.
Built CLI receives native session through stdin, uses trusted loopback TLS and records exact selected evidence; offline inspection leaves database bytes unchanged.
Packed matching client exposes operator methods, and installed CLI inspection redacts the stored grant.
publication: New commands and client methods require a build containing #1316 or a later coordinated package release. No npm publication was performed.
limitations: Manual confirmation attests the operator performed and verified external permission removal; it does not automate or cryptographically prove provider revocation.
The tests use synthetic identities, grants and evidence, not real provider accounts.
